text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Duta-Ulu Kelang Fasa 2 Sri Damansara Link) 2017.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Oktober 2017.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Sri Damansara Link yang merupakan

sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Duta-Ulu Kelang Fasa 2 yang bermula dari

kilometer 0.00 (di koordinat U 2712.212, T -9384.276 Grid Cassini Negeri Selangor)

di Jalan Lingkaran Tengah II (suatu jarak yang diukur dari Pejabat Pos Besar

Kuala Lumpur) dan berakhir di kilometer 0.19 (di koordinat U 2641.197, T -9207.207

Grid Cassini Negeri Selangor) termasuk Persimpangan Bertingkat Menjalara, iaitu suatu

jarak sepanjang 0.19 kilometer, diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (DUTA-ULU KELANG EXPRESSWAY PHASE 2 SRI DAMANSARA

LINK) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959 [Act 376],

the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes the

following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Duta-Ulu Kelang

Expressway Phase 2 Sri Damansara Link) Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 October 2017.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) That part of the road known as the Sri Damansara Link which is part of the

Duta-Ulu Kelang Expressway Phase 2 commencing from kilometre 0.00

(at coordinates N 2712.212, E -9384.276 of the Selangor State Cassini Grid) at the Middle

Ring Road II (a distance measured from the General Post Office Kuala Lumpur) and

ending at kilometre 0.19 (at coordinates N 2641.197, T -9207.207 of the Selangor State

Cassini Grid) including the Menjalara Interchange, being a distance of 0.19 kilometres,

is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown on

the map in the Schedule.
